candidate.user_submission: Pikin dey 18 months old. Mama talk say e get diarrhoea for 14 days now. Blood dey inside di stool. E no dey convulse now and e never convulse before. Pikin no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything wey e chop. Di pikin dey drink normal. E no dey restless or irritable. Skin pinch dey normal. Eye no dey sunken. Pikin no get cough or any wahala to breathe. E no get ear problem. E no get fever.
